items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: I learned that from talking with guys like Bill Holman and Larry Wilcox and you name it, and Mancini.

ctx.x: Did you learn that from books?

No. I learned that from talking with guys like Bill Holman and Larry Wilcox and you name it, and Mancini. The books, arranging books don’t exist. There are orchestration books. They teach you how to voice. Voicing is not arranging. Voicing is just one aspect of arranging. It’s just one thing. People talk about oh the secret voicings, voicings don’t
mean crap unless you get a melody that warrants having that sound, that voicing. Gil Evans —
